formal_baseline: original LLaDA low-confidence, 128 steps, generation length 256, block length 32
accuracy_parent: confirmed bidirectional v9 over symmetric_fast tau=0.004 and conservative symmetric tau=0.004 trajectories

development_evidence.two_trajectory_oracle: 16/32; v9 selected exactly 16/32, with three fast-to-accuracy recoveries and zero losses
development_evidence.fixed_rule_replay: 18/32; two recoveries and zero losses versus v9

method.horizontal: Generate the original LLaDA low-confidence trajectory as a third complete candidate in addition to v9's two attention-conditioned trajectories.
method.longitudinal: Retain v9's one-nat commit-path evidence and bidirectional block verification for choosing between fast and conservative attention trajectories.
method.public_guard: Original LLaDA may replace the v9-selected candidate only when it passes strictly more function examples already visible verbatim in the user prompt.
method.tie_or_no_examples: Always retain v9; do not generate the third trajectory when no parseable public example exists.

formal_unseen.status_at_registration: No correctness labels, outputs, selector scores, or candidate evidence inspected.
formal_unseen.gate: Strictly exceed v9 and original LLaDA with at least one v11-only recovery and no more v9-only losses than recoveries.

cross_domain.MATH_500: No parseable public function examples implies exact v9 fallback with no third-trajectory NFE.
cross_domain.promotion: A formal HumanEval win reaches the same Prism-aligned MATH and sampled MBPP/GSM audit path; code gains and task-generic results are reported separately.
